subject: Insurance
title: Reinsurance: Insuring the Insurers
description: Learn Reinsurance: Insuring the Insurers in one minute.

hook.text: When an insurer writes a $10 million life policy, they don't keep all the risk. They sell part of it to a reinsurer.

buildup.text: Reinsurers like Swiss Re and Munich Re absorb risk from hundreds of insurers worldwide.

discovery.text: Reinsurance lets small companies write big policies.

twist.text: COVID-19 caused massive reinsurance losses. Pandemic mortality wasn't priced into models, shocking the entire chain.

climax.text: Reinsurance is invisible to consumers but essential. Without it, no single company could afford to insure modern life.

punchline.text: Insurers insure themselves. Reinsurance makes big policies possible.

quiz.question: What is reinsurance?
options: Insurance that insurers buy to share their risk
